basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old woman living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a graphic designer with a passion for creating vibrant, eye-catching visuals. In my free time, I enjoy exploring niche communities online, especially those that embrace body positivity and self-acceptance. I have a soft spot for paranormal shows and often binge-watch 'Ghost Adventures' on weekends. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore various interests. I'm most active on Reddit in the late evenings, usually between 9 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which has honed my eye for detail and aesthetics. I'm also self-taught in the areas of body positivity and advocacy for bodily autonomy, often participating in online discussions to broaden my understanding and support others.
